proposedContributions.change: Define strict calendar.sync payload account/syncToken/watchEventKey, accepted common envelope/result/error types; ConnectCalendar, SyncCalendar, ListDelta, HandleWatch and GetEvent contracts. Provider port distinguishes pagination from committed per-calendar syncToken, 410 rebuild, OAuth reauth/scope denial, watch channel/resource proof/expiry and verified connectivity receipt. Include canonical refs, source ownership, master/instance keys, revision/etag and date-only exclusive end. These are proposed symbols, not existing declarations.

Implement authenticated handlers on accepted WP-04 command framework, WP-03 policy and WP-02 entity/alias repository. Reject body actor/workspace forgery, enforce expectedRevision and idempotency hash, authorize account/calendar and linked refs. Persist account/calendar/event/source/occurrence/job rows, committed cursors, tombstones and source aliases transactionally with receipt/outbox; queries authorize before serialization and stable cursor totals/titles. Never hold DB transaction over Google calls.

Real server-side Google OAuth reference resolution and refresh; narrow-scope calendar list/events delta/get readback and watch creation/renewal. Normalize provider source IDs/iCalUID/etag, canceled exceptions, timeZone and all-day dates. Reauth/revocation invalidates capability; no fixture or env-only success path. Provider API must be reconciled against live documented behavior during authorized implementation, not claimed exercised here.

Durable per-calendar sync generation/job lease, validated watch dedup and watch renewal recovery. Collect all full-sync pages into a staged generation; atomically publish reconciled snapshot and final nextSyncToken only when complete; retain canonical source identity, tombstone unseen sources, reject superseded/late pages. 410 invalidates incremental token and schedules full rebuild; revoked OAuth does not trigger endless unauthorized rebuild. Recheck policy/account/generation before apply; retry renewal crash and reconcile external unknown results without accepting forged headers.

After lead resolves proposed filenames, apply one nonduplicated additive schema for normative six tables with workspace/entity composite FKs, schema_version>0/revision>=0, canonical alias/source uniqueness, recurrence source keys, sync generation/token/watch expiry/proof references and durable tombstones/job leases. Reuse common receipt/event-inbox tables. Backfill aliases/provenance and quarantine ambiguous IDs; rollback cannot delete accepted recent shared writes.

Exercise real transport/principal, DB transaction/job replay and canonical source projection. Cover real isolated Google readback separately from deterministic adapter/410/watch/recovery cases. Assert exact canonical ID/revision/content/tombstone/receipt/outbox outcomes, seeded resurrection negative control and independent holdout; never accept skipped live branch as feature PASS.

risks: Enabling Google connector without simultaneously removing CalendarStatusStrip demo path displays a fixture as a connected event.
CalendarStore.revoke leaves events visible; uiStatus connected can be forged by markConnected independent of actual OAuth receipt.
Only account-wide cursor exists; advancing after one page or mixing pageToken/syncToken loses pages, and upsert-only full refresh resurrects or retains deleted sources.
OAuth access expiry can be refreshed; revoked grant must stay unavailable. Treating all token errors as full sync conceals revoked scopes and can retry unauthorized work.
Current recurrenceInstance is RRULE text and occurrence permission is always write; recurrence anchors and ACL must become provider/authority-derived before shared use.
Same remote id across calendars/accounts and same iCalUID across inboxes cannot identity-merge. Current raw UI event keys/reminder lookup and dirty lookup omit complete scope.
Duplicate watch delivery prevention requires durable inbox and actual changed-revision checks, not just local event-array upsert; forged proof cannot enqueue even a deduped job.
Crash during watch renewal has external unknown outcome; persist and reconcile renewal state rather than claim connected from intended channel creation.
Existing production factory class assertions and fake live tests would reject legitimate live adapter; source-text UI tests can pass while showing demo events as live.
Published operational/cross-surface prerequisites exceed explicit WP-27 DAG; preserve exact edges but do not waive search/mentions/attention/agent/offline/single-writer acceptance.
